nodes.label: .`flyway applied V1 and recorded it in its history`()
.`a username absent from users is rejected in each of the 7 player tables`()
.`a hero id absent from heroes is rejected in hero_skills, card_copies, equipment_pieces and player_cards`()
.`a stage of a missing chapter, enemy or drop rule is rejected`()
.`a chapter with a missing boss enemy or boss drop rule is rejected`()
.`a progress on a chapter and stage pair absent from stages is rejected`()
.`a wallet queue of a missing drop rule is rejected`()
.`deleting a user deletes that player's rows in the 7 player tables and leaves other players`()
.`deleting a hero referenced by a skill, card copy, leader or piece is rejected and keeps that row`()
.`deleting a drop rule referenced by a chapter, a stage or a wallet queue is rejected and keeps that row`()
.`deleting an enemy referenced by a chapter boss or a stage is rejected and keeps that row`()
.`deleting a chapter that has stages is rejected and keeps its stages`()
.`deleting a stage a progress points at is rejected and keeps that progress`()
.`a second enemy with the same four attributes is rejected`()
.`enemy attributes outside their bounds are rejected`()
.`drop rule values outside their bounds are rejected`()
